section.8: Prayer (Kitab Al-Salat): Detailed Injunctions about Witr

8.name_native: Prayer (Kitab Al-Salat): Detailed Injunctions about Witr

hadiths.text: Waki' and Ibn 'Uyainah said (explaining the meaning of taghanni):This means that the Qur'an makes a man neglect all other things, and be content with it
